summary: Make every current and future public user site and independent site public by default, while allowing explicit public/private/maintenance switching from the site administrator surface and the EKODI platform super-administrator surface through one central publication-state source.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly instructed EKODI on 2026-10-01 to apply this to all EKODI user and independent sites as a forced execution rule and to make publication status selectable from both the site administrator page and the platform super-administrator page.
implementation: api-worker.js platform and site-admin control API
platform-router-entry-worker.js publication enforcement and site-admin control injection
mandatoryRules: all current and future public user and independent sites automatically inherit the rule
new sites default to public and remain accessible before login
public, private and maintenance are the only publication states
private or maintenance requires an explicit authorized administrator choice
the platform super administrator may manage all sites while a site administrator may manage only that site
publication state never blocks administrator, authentication or API routes
private and maintenance responses are noindex, nofollow and noarchive
all publication mutations are audited and local override is forbidden
publication-state read failure preserves public availability rather than taking the site offline
rollback: Revert this amendment and the universal publication runtime through the guarded C2 path while preserving currently stored site publication states. Do not silently change a site from an administrator-selected private or maintenance state during rollback.

approvalEvidence.ownerInstruction: 좋아 에코디와 협의해서 에코디 전체 사용자 및 독립사이트에 강제실행규칙으로 설정하고 사이트 공개여부를 해당 관리자페이지와 최고관리자페이지에서 간단히 설정 선택 전환할 수 있게 해줘.
